rows.en: Please, go right on through.
May fortune favor you in battle!!
All right, we're heading back to Antlar!
As I suspected... we need the power of an Ultra Warrior...
That should do it. We're heading back to Antlar!
All right. Let's go check on the "Ride Gate."
Obtained the "Knight Brace". A new Mebius skill has been unlocked.
Obtained the "Knight Brace". Mebius can now use a new skill.
The entrance to the "Wasteland Zone" is in the southwest part of the "Quicksand Zone."
Ohh!! Mebi, my man!! You get it!! Let's be pals!!
May fortune favor you in battle!!
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Get them!
This is important. Let's hurry and get it back to camp.
...can you withstand the scorching hell of Metaheavy!?
So this is the reservoir...
...No time to stand around thinking. We're hurrying deeper in!!
Tch...! Damn you, Kazari... You won't get away with this...
Now, let's hurry and get it to camp. No telling when the enemy'll come to take it back!
Team Trinity... I will never forgive them...
No enemies around? Man, where's the fun in that?
We've got the weapons, too. Let's hurry up and get back to camp.
We've got the weapons, too. Let's hurry up and get back to camp.
I'm coming with you too, so I'll teach you anything you don't know.
I just know you guys'll storm the enemy's stronghold and bring it down!
Huh? What's my real job? Collecting Medals, obviously!
You can view tutorials at any time from the Camp Menu.
Bleeeeeegh!! What the hell's this feelin'!! It's freakin' gross!!
Leave The O to us!
He's gone to RX!!
All right! Next stop, the Hideout Cube!!
Looks like some kind of research facility.
...Yeah. It doesn't seem to be a trap... Let's go.
...in the very middle of undergoing modification surgery.
Tch! Didn't we already beat that guy? What the hell's going on!?
I'm Kamen Rider Skull. I'm investigating on my own, to rescue Rider 1 and Rider 2.
This appears to be a graveyard for kaijin who were sacrificed.
Oh, you finally made it! I was worried, you know? The enemies around here are pretty tough.
You did it! Let's hurry!!
We can't beat the Modified Bemstar as we are now! Let's look for the Polymer Plaster Bomb!
Even I don't know the lay of the land in this area. For now, let's head for that cross.
...Aaahh! Now I remember! That guy just now was the Gundam we ran into in the first Cube!
What was that just now? I've got a bad feeling about this...
The question is whether there are any in this Cube... Whatever. Let's go on a bit further.
It might be close by. I'm going to search the area. See you!
The Devil Gundam may be nearby. I'll hunt it down and smash it to pieces!!
I will find the Devil Gundam, no matter what! We'll meet again!!
The boulder was blown to pieces!!
A rock...? No... this is...!!
Fuhahahahaha!!! Farewell!!
It's a Greeed! One's close by...!
You idiot! She's dangerous. We're leaving her just as she is!
There's gotta be a key somewhere, right? A room nobody can open is no use... We're searching!
Prepare yourselves!! I'll make you feel the terror of Alien Zarab until you're sick of it!!
Wing Zero and the others decided to shelter Kanegon and take their new charge back to base.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Got it. We'll give it a try.
The boulder was blown to pieces!!
The cross is just ahead. Let's hurry.
Obtained the "Broken Permidar Drill".
If I can repair it properly, we should be able to fit it to the Ride Machine.
Use the "Execution Ground Key"?
Ultraman joined the party!
Ultraseven joined the party!
Be careful when you take him on.
...will surely take revenge as a vengeful spirit...! I'll await you in a future of ruin...!!
Red King's corpse is gone.
Modified Bemstar's corpse is gone.
This is nothing like I imagined. It's like a land of ice.
Roger!
Either way, we're heading for that Colosseum.
...I'm looking forward to a good fight!!
We'll let you know over the arena PA when it's time. Till then, just wait around here somewhere.
Abiiih!! Abi-abi! Abiiih!!
Kikikikiki!!
Get out!
Let's both give it our all!

notes.note: Mis-decoded legacy text; read as 'please go through' (row 1 is likewise mis-decoded 'we have heard from Master Deathscythe Hell'). Speaker label says Waste Yummy, but the line is a guard letting the team past, almost certainly a Maganac (legacy tables have shifted speaker ids: 0225 'Waste Yummy' row is Antlar's roar).
Mis-decoded legacy text; same shape and same Maganac guard scene as 0219 #0.4 ('good fortune in battle'), so rendered identically. Guess.
Mis-decoded verb read as 'confirm/check' (tashikame). 00 after Antlar's nest vanishes.
Last leader variant (Wing Zero / Heero); rows 5-9 are the other leaders' versions.

Not played by 0230.bla's constant calls; Ride Machine naming scene (rows 114-128) is Momotaros's, so this reply to Mebius's 'It's wonderful!!' is Momotaros. The rough 'Mebi-kou' nickname rendered 'Mebi, my man'.
Metaheavy (no name box in script); finishes row 7 'But you lot...'.
Last leader variant = 00 (script CharaNameIn 00); identical Japanese to rows 1-8.
Script shows Mebius for the +35+7 variant; voice fits (rows 36-42 = 00, Nu, Zeta, OOO, W, Den-O, Zero).
Zero's pair (rows 17-18), from script CharaNameIn Zero.
Script's last speaker is Seravee (Tieria uses boku); identical Japanese to 0230 #0.108, so its existing English is reused. Speaker labels in rows 96-102 of this table look shifted.
Zero's pair (+151+16, TextIdOffset 6); same Japanese as rows 168/170.
Ankh's line in the last four-line leader group; same as rows 84, 88, 92...
Base scene rows 220-234 are played by Base/Command/0912.bla; its last call (+233) is Zero.
Last leader variant = Wing Zero; same Japanese as rows 8-10.
Wing Zero (script); same Japanese as row 36.
Narration continuing row 4 'A kaijin strapped down to a bed...'; English cut to continue that sentence.
No name box (MessWinIn only); alternate of row 47. Item name per 0315 rows.
Last leader variant = Black RX (script).
'Any' = Core Medals, from rows 4-10.
The ??? speaker is the disguised God Gundam (Domon); 'it' = Devil Gundam from row 36.
0325.bla stops at row 137; rows 138-139 are not played. Speaker inferred as God Gundam (his reply after the leaders' DG Cell lines).
Party-leader line (pt_01); same Japanese as rows 11-14, 16-17.
'She' = Mezool (rows 4-8).
Wing Zero-leader version of row 171; worded the same.
Not played by 0339.bla. Read as the team answering Hikari's Spiner explanation (rows 18-21); speaker unknown, 'we' used.
Mis-decoded legacy text; same shape as 0328 #0.74 'the boulder shattered' after the Spiner prompt in row 1. Guess.
Item name per glossary 'Permidar Drill' and the existing 'Broken Permidar Drill' handover line.
Mis-decoded legacy text read as 'repair' and 'equip'. Hikari about the Zeroliner drill.
Item rendered as the existing 'Execution Ground Key' (Left/Right variants elsewhere); this prompt uses the bare name.
Not played by 0358.bla; alternate of row 126, Zoffy warning about Yapool.
Continues row 197 'I, Yapool...'.
Alternate of row 226; reply to Zoffy's orders.

report: 80/80 rows. Mis-decoded legacy guesses: 0218 #2, 0225 #13, 0231 #2, 0340 #3, 0343 #5. Speakers inferred (not played by their scripts): 0230 #129 Momotaros, 0325 #139 God Gundam, 0339 #22 (unknown, 'we'), 0358 #152 Zoffy. 0218 #2 label 'Waste Yummy' is likely a Maganac. No new names.
